title: An uncooperative tool against the executor's containment
note: D-2026-149 (findings R-1, R-2). Each mutation removes one piece of kernel containment or of its reporting. tests/test_execution_containment.py pairs each isolated case with an isolate=False control that shows the threat on this host. Run with HARNESS_ISOLATION_REQUIRED=1, so a host without unprivileged namespaces fails instead of skipping (the shard job sets it only where the runner allows namespaces; see DEPLOYMENT.md).

mutations.name: EC1_isolation_claimed_and_not_applied
mutations.replace: prefix, isolation = (((), namespace_isolation()[1]) if limits.isolate else
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: the run records namespaces it never entered; the escapee and the network are back

mutations.name: EC2_isolate_false_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: a caller cannot turn isolation off, and the controls that show the threat stop showing it

mutations.name: EC3_no_pid_namespace
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: R-1: without a PID namespace a setsid() grandchild outlives the run

mutations.name: EC4_no_network_namespace
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: R-2: the tool reaches the host's loopback and whatever else routes

mutations.name: EC5_no_descriptor_bound
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: R-2: the tool holds as many descriptors as its supervisor

mutations.name: EC6_the_inits_report_is_ignored
mutations.find:
if status_r is not None:
            # What the namespace's init reported
mutations.replace:
if False:
            # What the namespace's init reported
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: a tool killed by a signal under isolation is reported as exiting 128+n

mutations.name: EC7_the_namespace_init_is_skipped
mutations.find:
full_argv = [*prefix, sys.executable, "-I", "-S", str(_NS_INIT),
                     str(status_w), "--confine", limits.confine,
                     json.dumps(policy, sort_keys=True), "--", *argv]
mutations.rationale: D-2026-149: the tool is PID 1 of its namespace: its own SIGTERM is ignored and its signal deaths are lost
